scenes.say: Want fewer runtime bugs? How strict is your TypeScript setup?

scenes.label: strict
scenes.sub: Turns on all strict type checks for you.
scenes.say: Strict mode flips on every strict type check, making your code more reliable.
For a solid setup, set strict for safety, target for JavaScript version, module for system type, esModuleInterop for compatibility, and outDir for your build files.

scenes.question: Is strictNullChecks enough for safety?
scenes.right: Strict mode covers all checks, not just nulls.
scenes.say: Careful—strictNullChecks alone isn't enough. Strict mode covers all the bases, not just null values.
